pattern.description: Screen recording: the idea detail side panel is dismissed and the Delivery list view re-lays out to full width, exposing extra columns and header actions; cursor then hovers rows.
pattern.why_premium: Closing the detail panel returns to the full table in one beat, so the viewer sees the delivery fields in context right as the narration says 'surface this delivery field'.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.detail-panel', {xPercent: 100, autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.in'}).fromTo(['.col-goal', '.col-status', '.col-assignee', '.header-actions'], {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power1.out', stagger: 0.03}, '<0.1')
build_hint.remotion: panelX = interpolate(frame, [0, 8], [0, 100], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); column opacity = interpolate(frame, [3, 9], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); no spring, UI state swap.

notes: Raw screen recording; panel close appears as a near-instant swap (single energy spike), so fade/step is approximate. Hover tooltip on rows is cursor interaction, not authored motion.
